decisions.statement: A filter row is drawn only once the player picks that filter from the add menu.
Removing a row clears the value that row was holding.
A removed row is hidden and reused rather than rebuilt.
The panel hides whenever the inventory scene hides.
The panel reanchors each time the inventory scene shows.
Nothing here decides whether an item passes a filter.

definition: the movable panel a player adds filter rows to while the inventory is open
